name: Swelling Forces

angles.text: The naga in these ruins were once Highborne kindred of the night elves. Their return to desecrate and pillage the ancient forests alongside dark cultists is a bitter betrayal.
Alliance forces defending the sacred forests around Darkshore and the Grove of the Ancients face a coordinated front of naga and Twilight's Hammer.

faq.answer: Arbal gives the order from the Grove of the Ancients, directing defenders against the hostile naga gathering in the northeast ruins.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Swelling Forces?

faq.answer: The Stormscale naga have occupied the nearby ruins and threaten the surrounding woodlands. They also aid the Twilight's Hammer cult, bringing violence to lands they once called home.
faq.q: Why are the naga being targeted in this quest?

faq.answer: The naga were once Highborne elves of ancient Kalimdor, changed by a terrible curse. They once lived in these cities and have returned as serpents seeking conquest and devastation.
faq.q: What is the connection between the naga and the ruins?

faq.answer: The Stormscale naga are assisting the Twilight's Hammer cult. Arbal warns that their alliance threatens further ruin for the ancient forests.
faq.q: What is the naga's connection to the Twilight's Hammer?

faq.answer: The Stormscale forces gather in ruins northeast of the Grove of the Ancients. Defenders are sent to curb their growing numbers there.
faq.q: Where do the Stormscale forces gather?

faq.answer: Arbal considers it unforgivable that the naga pillage their ancient homeland at a dark master's command. Their former Highborne nobility has given way to cruelty and dark alliances.
faq.q: Why does Arbal consider the naga's actions unforgivable?

sections.body: Arbal watches the northeast ruins from the Grove of the Ancients with grave concern. Cursed Highborne have become the serpent-like naga of the Stormscale tribe. They now occupy the remains of their old civilization, and their growing army could spread beyond the ruins into the wider forest. Arbal sends defenders there to cut down their numbers before that happens.
sections.title: Serpents in the Sunken City

sections.body: Arbal warns that the Stormscale naga aid the Twilight's Hammer cult. These former Highborne now desecrate and pillage the forests that once sheltered them, serving sinister masters. To Arbal, this is unforgivable. Their numbers must be curbed before the cult and its serpentine allies tighten their hold on the land.
sections.title: An Unholy Alliance

summary: At the Grove of the Ancients, Arbal sends defenders against the Stormscale naga in the northeast ruins. These cursed former Highborne threaten the surrounding woodlands as their numbers grow.
